title: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Android: front-of-room display defaults to attendee view in Town Hall (GCC High and DoD)
summary: The briefing passes: the attendee-view default, Teams Rooms Pro requirement, and events-policy controls are supported. One minor clarification is needed: the other roadmap item's webinar-development note differs from release notes that document the webinar experience in June 2026.

claims.where: controls[0].ui and controls[0].api; summary; Why it matters; Governance controls
claims.claim: No administrator UI policy or automation for the default Town Hall front-of-room view is documented in November 2026.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Teams Rooms Android town hall front-of-room default view admin policy configuration XML PowerShell Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy'; '"front-of-room" "Town Hall" "default" "policy" Android'. Read rooms-release-note, set-up-events, Set-CsTeamsEventsPolicy and searched Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy.

claims.claim: The UI control is in Teams admin center at Meetings > Events policies > policy > Events optimized for a large audience.
claims.quote:
go to **Meetings** > **Events policies**.
2. Select an existing policy or create a new one.
For events optimized for large audiences, such as town halls, turn the **Events optimized for a large audience** toggle **On** or **Off**.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsEventsPolicy -Identity <policy name> -AllowTownhalls Disabled prevents organizers with that policy from creating events optimized for large audiences.
claims.quote:
To prevent organizers with this policy from creating events optimized for large audiences, run the following command:

Set-CsTeamsEventsPolicy -Identity <policy name> -AllowTownhalls Disabled

claims.where: controls[1].governs, scope and note; Risk assessment; Governance; Governance controls
claims.claim: The events policy is a user-scoped event-creation control, not a control of the room's front-of-room view.
claims.quote: **Events optimized for a large audience** (On,Off) | `-AllowTownhalls` (Enabled,Disabled) | Controls whether users with this policy can create events optimized for large audiences, such as town halls.

claims.claim: The Set-CsTeamsEventsPolicy reference still labels the policy as preview.
claims.quote: This cmdlet allows you to configure options for customizing Teams events experiences. Note that this policy is currently still in preview.

claims.claim: If the scheduling-policy value is changed to Off after a user schedules an event, the user cannot run or start it.
claims.quote: If you change the value to **Off** after a user schedules an event, they can't run or start the event.
